theorem lg_target (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) : x + 1 / x ≥ 2 := by
  have h1 : (x + 1 / x) / 2 ≥ sqrt (x * (1 / x)) :=
    real.arithmetic_mean_le_geometric_mean x (inv x)
  have h2 : sqrt (x * (1 / x)) = 1 :=
    by rw [mul_inv_cancel hx, sqrt_one]
  rw [h2] at h1
  have h3 : (x + 1 / x) / 2 ≥ 1 := h1
  rwa [mul_div_right] at h3
